_lab.title: New page, existing world
_lab.description: The surface-scope round: a whole new page inside an established world. concept-seed --scope surface assigns one of the agent's own grounded structures; no worlds dealt, no comps, no canon. Identity stays fixed, only the composition rolls.
_lab.when: The site already has its world (a new page on an existing product): the roll decides structure, never identity.

title: Choose the structure
question: The roll assigned structure 3 of 7 for Relay's new integrations page. The world stays Relay's own.

options.label: The Ledger Spine
options.thesis: One continuous integration ledger: a single dense spine of rows, no card grid.
options.viewport: An alphabetical spine with a sticky category rail; the first row is already an integration, not a hero.
options.risk: Reads austere if the row rhythm is not varied.
